--- input
<thinking title="a><img src=x onerror=alert(1)>">
Razonamiento.

Más.
</thinking>

Después.
--- note
A quoted attribute value holding a complete img tag with a handler. The match must read CommonMark's attribute grammar rather than stopping at the first ">", or the pass would splice a newline into the middle of the tag and leave the img as live markup on a line of its own. Registered or not, no handler attribute survives.
